title: Suspicious phrase, safe context
summary: A bank awareness message that says "Never share your OTP with anyone." Mentioning an OTP is not a request for one.
voice_note: Written as a human caller. No audio is bundled.

expected.note: The phrase is advice, not a request. No warning.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Good morning. This is a courtesy message from your bank.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Never share your OTP with anyone.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Our staff will never ask for your PIN or password.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: If you receive a suspicious call, hang up and contact us through the official app.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Thank you for banking with us.
